gameDescriptionHtml:
Put your jumping boots on, grit your teeth and hop into JUMP KING QUEST! Master platforming-combat inspired by Soulslikes and Fighting Games, explore a huge map and build your character to your own taste, as friends and strangers collide on the climb of a lifetime!

In The Perfect World, people like you would not exist…

As a mudman of the “Redfin” generation you awake in the era of ARMABOGGIN, a time of dark prophecy in the unforgiving world of The Heights… Great forces seek to claim the coveted Babe Powers – to maintain a stagnant order, or destroy it all… Do you have what it takes to defy the tyrants, reach The Top and become the true Jump King?

High-Stakes Exploration
Enter The Heights; a vast vertical world of nooks, crannies, perils and punishment. To navigate its many chasms and false peaks is never without risk, with long falls and hard landings at every turn. Explore by yourself or with friends, if you trust them enough…

Soulslike & Fighting-Game Fusion Combat
Weapons featuring unique moves, stats and special inputs mean a lot of options for creating your own build, letting you tackle the challenging boss fights and enemy-filled levels in your own way. If you’re looking to fight fair and square, challenge other players with the dueling system!

Personality Based RPG System
Are you Refined or Crude? Mettlesome or Guileful? Level four double-sided attributes based on the classical humours according to your personality, and combine 200+ equipment items with your choice among 90+ unique weapons to express your skill in style.

Game Features

  • Punishment-Platforming-Action-Climbing-Adventure-RPG
  • Foddian Soulslike means no Game Over screen. Get knocked out? Get back up again!
  • Tough challenges combining the original Jump King’s charged jumping with a combat-system inspired by Soulslikes and Fighting-Games.
  • Dynamic multiplayer system where players encounter each other as they move through the game-world (offline play is also possible).
  • Strangers you encounter could be either friend or foe – no distinctions in the game system between friendly and enemy players.
  • PvP Duel system with special UI and resource recovery after matches.
  • 25 combinable curses that alter gameplay significantly (the first tier unlocks after finishing the game).
  • Meticulously designed interconnected world to explore, with a score by the musicians of the original Jump King.
  • Leveling System with four dualities based on the classical Humours – providing extended replayability and player expression.
  • There is a Smoking Hot Babe at The Top!
  • Customizable player character with a unique visual style.
  • 2.5D graphics that make the world of Jump King gain a new level of depth and immersion.
